TITLE: Points and Lines Gradient Editor
BIHARMONIC_NOTE: A stiff sheet held at the stops: smooth everywhere, overshooting past the stops' colors where it bends, most of all near the edges.
HARMONIC_NOTE: A stretched membrane held at the stops: never overshoots, but creased at each one.
SHEET_NOTE: One component as a height over the box. The harmonic model is a membrane pinned at the stops: it rises to a sharp peak or dips to a pit at each point, and is creased along each line. The biharmonic model is a stiff sheet that bends smoothly through them, and past a stop it keeps going, above 1 or below 0. Drag to turn it.
